profile_text.body:
Lokalise describes itself as a continuous localization and translation management platform that integrates into a development workflow so teams can ship localized products faster. According to its site, it brings localization into one system that connects workflows, standardizes execution, and uses AI to deliver consistent, on-brand experiences across markets. The company was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Newark, Delaware.

Its AI offering, tracked as Lokalise AI, covers localization AI, continuous translation, and developer workflow, and is noted as UK-hosted. Per the site, the AI applies approved terminology, tone of voice, and vocabulary to keep translations consistent with a brand across languages. It also describes Custom AI Profiles, surrounding context, and metadata for preserving meaning, AI Scoring to evaluate translation quality automatically so only low-confidence results need human review, and dynamic routing to the best-fit LLM based on language, content, and context. Role-based access control is described as applying across the platform and its API, with API access using the same model as the web interface. The site also notes that AI translation tools cannot fully replace human translators.

The held record shows law exposure in Delaware with a count of 33, and no cases are recorded. No MCP servers are listed for the company.
